messages:
Aisha: FYI someone left a lone rubber duck by the coffee machine and now its a shrine.
Ben: not me. but i approve. rubber duckies improve sprint velocity.
Ravi: it started as a joke and now we have an official mascot. meet Quackstein.
Nora: Quackstein deserves a backstory. origin: rescued from a box of swag. powers: gives helpful code hints at 3pm.
Ben: i nominate Quackstein as interim CTO of morale.
Aisha: petition to add a tiny cape and a nameplate: "Quackstein, Keeper of the Kettle"
Reacji Bot: added :quackstein: emoji (reaction: :sparkles:)
Ravi: also proposing a lore entry: anyone who takes coffee without offering a rubber duck salute owes a donut.
Nora: rules committee formed. members: Ben (chair), Aisha (decor), Ravi (fluff).
Ben: i will draft a 2-sentence origin myth for onboarding: "Quackstein arrived during a midnight deploy and whispered the hotfix that saved release day."
Aisha: perfect. can we get stickers? tiny cape optional.
Ravi: sticker run of 30, please. also optional embroidered patch for laptop corners.
Nora: new tradition: when someone finishes a tricky bug, place Quackstein on their desk for 24 hours.
Ben: agreed. documenting in the handbook addendum: "Quackstein Protocol"
Aisha: this thread is now canonical lore. future hires will be judged by their salute.
Ravi: salute: two-finger tap on the duck, say "quack on". very serious.
Nora: anyone caught disrespecting Quackstein must perform a celebratory docker-compose down dance.
Reacji Bot: pinned message to #random: "Quackstein lore  honorary mascot and rituals"
Ben: ok were done. sticker mockups incoming.
Aisha: long live Quackstein :duck:
